mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper directly supports antibacterial phenotype improvement for Kalpha3-KFGGI using inhibition-zone-derived CL values; this is not a molecular killing-mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Kalpha3-KFGGI compared with MeuTxKalpha3 and P30N
mechanism_claims.limitations: Activity is measured as CL from inhibition zones; membrane permeabilization or intracellular target assays are not reported.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Loop replacement with the KFGGI c-loop motif is supported as a structural design rationale and model context, not as direct proof of a killing mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure 1/modeling and CD data support design/fold context only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper does not directly test K+ channel blockade for Kalpha3-KFGGI; the channel-function statement remains an author conjecture and is not normalized to a direct mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No local electrophysiology or channel-blockade assay value is reported for Kalpha3-KFGGI.
